what_it_holds: MIT-licensed repo (the original source behind the well-known Kaggle "Brazilian E-Commerce Public Dataset by Olist") holding sample relational tables extracted from Olist's real marketplace: orders, order items/prices, freight value, products, sellers (9,000+), customers, and reviews, covering hundreds of thousands of orders across Brazil; includes an ER-diagram schema.
why_useful: A real (not synthetic) multi-table ecommerce marketplace transaction dataset with prices, freight/shipping cost, seller counts, delivery times and customer reviews by Brazilian region — useful as a structural template for how a two-sided marketplace's take-rate/logistics-cost/review data can be organized, and as a LatAm regional ecommerce-activity dataset in its own right (LatAm demand is gap #7).
time_coverage: 2016-2018 order history (per the well-known Kaggle companion release; exact span not restated on this page)

last_activity: not shown; used as a stable hiring-assessment reference dataset
size_hint: hundreds of thousands of orders, 950,000+ products, 9,000+ sellers per repo description
themes: Retail and ecommerce alt-data open samples (web-scraped prices, Amazon rank), as templates for platform KPI nowcasting
